prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, audience and the services you need. That said, one notable firm with deep local roots and a strong healthcare/medical communications practice is FleishmanHillard (headquartered in St. Louis). They’re a large, full-service global agency and often a good fit for hospitals, health systems and national healthcare brands seeking integrated PR, digital and brand work.

If you want a more tailored recommendation, tell me:
- Are you a hospital/health system, clinic, private practice, med device company, payer, biotech, or another type of healthcare organization?
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician referrals, product launch, crisis communications, internal communications, digital advertising, content)?
- Typical monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Geography (local St. Louis only, regional, national)?
- Timeline and any mandates (certifications, HIPAA experience, prior agency relationships)?

If you’d like now, I can:
- Compile a short list (3–6) of St. Louis-based healthcare marketing agencies that match your needs, with strengths, sample work and estimated pricing ranges.
- Provide a comparison matrix and suggested interview questions.

Quick checklist of how to evaluate agencies:
- Relevant healthcare experience (hospitals, med devices, payer, biotech)
- HIPAA or PHI-handling processes if applicable
- Case studies and measurable results (KPIs)
- Cross-channel capabilities (digital, SEO, paid media, content, PR)
- Team seniority and who will do the day‑to‑day work
- Reporting cadence and KPIs
- References from similar clients
- Pricing model (retainer vs project vs performance)

Sample questions to ask agencies in an interview:
- Tell me about two healthcare clients similar to us and the results you achieved.
- Who on your team would work on our account, and what are their backgrounds?
- How do you handle HIPAA/PHI in campaigns?
- What KPIs do you recommend for our goals, and how often will you report?
- Can you share a recent crisis communications example and the outcomes?

Tell me the details above and I’ll put together a short, prioritized list of St. Louis agencies that fit.
